senses.gloss:
अखेटिक अखेटिक or आखेटिक, अस्, m. a dog
trained to the chase.

आखेटिक, अस्, ई, अम्, who or what hunts; terrible,
frightful; (अस्), m. a hound; a hunter.

अखेदिन् अ-खेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, not wearisome;
unwearied.
—अखेदि-त्व, अम्, n. continuous flow (of
speech); one of the vāgguṇas of the Jainas.

आखेट आ-खेट, अस्, m. (rt. खिट् ?), chase,
hunting; terror, fright.
—आखेट-शीर्षक, अम्, n.
a cavern, a mine.

आ-खेटक, अस्, आ, अम्, hunting, a hunter; fright-
ening, frightful; (अम्), n. hunting, chase.
